definitions.explanation: The current month; the month we are in now. Used to talk about events or plans within the present month.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しいです。
{今月|こんげつ}の{天気|てんき}はどうですか。
{今月|こんげつ}は{誕生日|たんじょうび}です。
{今月|こんげつ}の{終|お}わりに{友達|ともだち}と{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く{予定|よてい}なので、{今|いま}から{楽|たの}しみです。
examples.english: I'm planning to go on a trip with friends at the end of this month, so I'm already looking forward to it.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}かったですが、{来月|らいげつ}は{晴|は}れる{日|ひ}が{多|おお}いので、{出|で}かけることが{楽|たの}しみです。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain this month, but next month will have many sunny days, so I'm looking forward to going out.

notes:
TIME REFERENCE SERIES:
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month

The {今|こん} prefix means "this" or "current" and forms a pattern with other time words:
- {今日|きょう}: today
- {今週|こんしゅう}: this week
- {今年|ことし}: this year (note irregular reading)
- {今朝|けさ}: this morning (irregular reading)

USAGE:
Can function as both a noun ({今月|こんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しい) and adverbially ({今月|こんげつ}{届|とど}く).
